title: ℕ ⊂ ℤ ⊂ ℚ ⊂ ℝ
caption: Each set sits inside the next: √9 = 3 is natural (so also an integer, rational and real), −3 is an integer but not natural, 0.75 = 3/4 is rational but not an integer, and √10 and π are irrational: real, but in no smaller set.
alt: Four nested rounded boxes: ℕ inside ℤ inside ℚ inside ℝ. √9 is in ℕ; −3 in ℤ only; 0.75 in ℚ only; √10 and π in ℝ only.
description: The innermost box is the natural numbers ℕ and holds √9 = 3.
Around it, the integers ℤ add −3.
Around that, the rationals ℚ add 0.75 = 3/4.
The outer box, the reals ℝ, adds the irrationals √10 and π.
